text:
On the ridge above Harrowmere, where the wind comes off the estuary and the old allotment fences still lean in rows, there is now a surveyor's stake every few metres. Garrow Heights, long discussed and long delayed, has found its money.

Calloway Mutual is the bank financing the scheme. The arrangement was announced on 14 March 2023, and Delphine Ashworth-Reyes, Head of Residential Lending at Calloway Mutual, confirmed it. The loan facility totals £48.6 million and will fund 212 homes.

The details rest on the Garrow Heights Development Financing Agreement, filed with the Harrowmere Borough Planning Registry.

For a site that has spent years as an argument rather than a place, the filing carries a quiet weight. Residents who once debated whether anything would be built now ask a different question: what the ridge will look like when it is.
